text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Ruby. I'd love to give you 
a gift to celebrate—is there anything you 
want?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No... your kind wishes are more than 
enough. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Really...? Still, since it's a special 
occasion, I want to give you something."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I saw a glasswork hairpin at a shop the 
other day. I thought right away that it 
would look lovely on Ruby...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but someone like you probably 
already has tons of way nicer accessories, 
huh? Sorry, let me get something else—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There is no such thing as... 
'unnecessary.'

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Really? That's great. In that case, I'll 
go pick out something extra special for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...Just please don't 
overdo it.
